notes: Ashby public job posting API (developers.ashbyhq.com, Job Postings API): GET /posting-api/job-board/{token} gives every job with its posting: title, location, secondaryLocations[{location, address}], workplaceType (Remote, Hybrid, OnSite or null), isRemote, isListed, publishedAt, employmentType (FullTime, PartTime, Intern, Contract, Temporary), address.postalAddress.addressCountry, descriptionPlain, descriptionHtml, jobUrl, applyUrl. Companies: posthog, n8n; sentry and every other token 404.
